notes: whose fuses the relative s010 and the possessive suffix s014 in one discontinuous unit; the single English word still carries both morphemes' sense, so distance does not break it (rules 30, 35).

im-lo is split, with if on the particle and Surely on the negative, because the ASV writes two English words and dropping if loses the conditional particle's own rendering; the rule 30 fusion reading is named in the unit's note.
canst not is written as two words, so the negative takes only not and the modal stays with the verb (rule 35).
